parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, Frisco’s Health Club, Andy’s speaking.

Oh, hello. The reason I’m ringing is I’d like to make inquiries about buying a membership, not for myself, but for a relative. Have I got through to the right person?

Oh yes. How can I help you? What would you like to know?

Well, the club was recommended by the friend of a friend and I am not exactly sure where you are. Could you explain?

We’re at the Grange.

Oh yes, I know. Isn’t that Wickham Road?

Nearly. It’s actually Wickford Road, W-I-C-K-F-O-R-D.

Oh right. I’ve got that. And that’s in Red Heaton, isn’t it?

That’s right. We’re actually just at the back of the market.

Okay. Now, as I said, the person I want to buy the membership for is not myself, but my sister as a birthday present.

Would you mind my asking if she works full-time?

No, she doesn’t. You see, we have two types of membership package. The gold is best for people who work full-time. I think the most suitable deal for her would be our silver package.

So, what exactly does that mean?

It means she’d be able to use all the facilities from 7.30 in the morning. Although we’re looking at opening at 6.30 if there’s enough interest, until 3.45 every day.

And what does that work out as?

Well, at the moment, we’re offering a reduced price as we are expanding. And not all of our new facilities have been built yet. It’s £25 off, making it £40. That’s a month.

That sounds good. And I know some clubs have something they call a joining fee. Do you have one of those?

Yes, it’s £30.

Okay. And what facilities do you have at the club?

Well, we have a fitness studio with all the usual equipment like exercise bikes and rowing machines.

Oh, good. She’ll like that. But I suppose you’ve got a swimming pool.

Yes, there’s a 20-meter pool, and if your sister’s interested in tennis, we’ve got facilities for that as well.

Indoors?

No, outdoors. We’ve just started building some indoor squash courts, though. They should be open in a couple of months.

And do you do things like yoga classes?

No. Sorry. But we are running dance classes on Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays. I don’t know if your sister would be interested in them.

You know, I just think she might. Oh, and do you have a sauna? She’s very keen on that.

Not at the moment, but we do have plans to build one in our next phase of building. And we just opened a hairdressers, though I should mention they’re not open on Sundays.

Right.

And if your sister fancies a drink and something to eat after all her hard work, we’ve got a cafe which is open every day of the week, including weekends. There are plans to open a juice bar, too, in the future.

Okay. And can I just ask if my sister forgets her towel? Can she get one here?

Oh, yes, no problem. Just ask at reception. There is a charge, though, of 50p each. We also have balls and rackets for hire, too. That costs a bit more, of course.

Well, that all sounds very good. What should I do now?

Well, the normal procedure is to see John Weissman, our admissions manager, and just bring along details of your bank account, and a couple of photos for the forms.

Well, I’ll get the details together and call in tomorrow.

Fine. We’ll see you then. I’m sure your sister will enjoy her present.

analyses.content: 男士纠正了女士的说法，明确拼读了街道名称 W-I-C-K-F-O-R-D，直接照着字母写下来即可。
It’s actually Wickford Road, W-I-C-K-F-O-R-D.
千万别填女士一开始猜的 Wickham，那是错误的干扰项，后面 No, actually... 才是正确答案的开始。
The gold is best for people who work full-time. I think the most suitable deal for her would be our silver package.
听到 Gold 别急着填，录音说那是给全职工作者（people who work full-time）准备的。
男士解释说，因为你妹妹不全职工作（doesn't work full-time），所以最适合她的套餐是 silver package。
It means she’d be able to use all the facilities from 7.30 in the morning.
别填 6.30，那是以后人多才可能开放的时间（looking at opening... if there's enough interest），不是现在的。
题目问开始时间，录音中男士说可以从早上 7.30 开始使用设施。
It’s £25 off, making it £40. That’s a month.
别填 25，那是折扣减去的钱（£25 off），不是最终要付的钱。
录音说现在有优惠，减去25镑后，最终价格是 making it £40（变成40镑）。
And I know some clubs have something they call a joining fee. Do you have one of those? Yes, it’s £30.
听到数字 30 前面的核心名词就是答案，直接照搬 joining fee，不要只写 fee。
女士问有没有 joining fee，男士确认说有（Yes），并且是 30 镑，对应题干冒号后的 $30。
题目问哪种球场是户外的（outdoor only），录音中提到 tennis 时，男士明确回答 Indoors? No, outdoors.。
...if your sister’s interested in tennis, we’ve got facilities for that as well. Indoors? No, outdoors.
别填 squash，录音说壁球场是室内的（indoor）而且还在建，不符合题目要求。
But we are running dance classes on Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays.
别填 yoga，录音明确说了 No. Sorry，这是典型的否定干扰。
男士说虽然没有瑜伽，但他们正在开设 dance classes，对应题干的课程填空。
...we’ve got a cafe which is open every day of the week, including weekends.
别填 hairdressers，录音特意说它周日不开（not open on Sundays）；也别填 juice bar，那是未来的计划。
题目问什么设施每天都开，录音说 cafe is open every day of the week。
And can I just ask if my sister forgets her towel? ... There is a charge, though, of 50p each.
别填 balls 或 rackets，虽然也能租，但录音说它们要更贵一点（cost a bit more），不是 50p。
题目问在前台能租到什么（且费用是 50p），录音说如果忘记带 towel，可以在前台拿，费用 50p。
...and just bring along details of your bank account, and a couple of photos for the forms.
注意要填复数 photos，因为录音里说的是 a couple of（几张/一对），而且照片通常不止一张。
男士说办理手续需要带银行信息和几张 photos（照片）。
